question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**buy**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Buy **means **to purchase**.

 
 
• Example - ***Charlie buys three chocolates every day.***
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, Things that money can buy 'goods' such as
